focused.note: Existing suite only; keyboard/focus cases absent

findings.failure: Ctrl/Cmd+K is not gated on dialog.open and calls navigate('memory') which render()s the page behind the modal.
findings.invariant: While a modal dialog is open it owns keyboard input; background view must not change.
findings.evidence: static: keydown handler has no dialog.open check (inventory contracts_observed.ctrl_k_gated_on_dialog_open=false)

findings.failure: Ctrl/Cmd+K always navigate()→render(), recreating #memory-query and #setup-path and discarding live typing.
findings.invariant: Search shortcut focuses the existing field without destroying in-progress input. Contrast: app-client.test.ts:171-182 already requires not replacing #memory-query on operation-banner pulse.
findings.correction: If already on memory and #memory-query exists, focus it; do not render(). Do not fire on welcome setup.

findings.failure: openDialog calls showModal() before callers append fields/actions; the only focusable at showModal time is button[aria-label='Close dialog']. No autofocus.
findings.invariant: Initial dialog focus is the first complete meaningful control (first field or explicit cancel), not an incomplete tree.
findings.correction: Append the full tree then showModal(), or focus the first field after append.

findings.failure: Skip-link targets #main[tabindex=-1] but main{outline:none}, so skip landing has no visible focus indicator.
findings.invariant: Keyboard focus is visible, including skip-to-content landing.

findings.failure: Search input uses outline:none!important; group .search-form:focus-within provides an alternative indicator whose contrast was not measured.
findings.invariant: Visible focus on the search group.
findings.correction: Owner browser check; do not treat as pass here.

findings.failure: Ctrl/Cmd+K preventDefault runs even when #memory-query is absent (welcome/disconnected).
findings.invariant: Shortcut is a no-op unless the search field exists.

hypotheses_untested_in_browser: Native modal dialog traps Tab and restores the opener on Escape (expected HTML behavior; not observed).
loadService()/search() render() can drop focus on the control the user was using (F11 in the map).
Focus-visible contrast on buttons/links meets WCAG against both color schemes.
